Hi Liam — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments.

Short answers up front: an electronic notarization (DocuSign/Notarize) is acceptable in most cases, but our tax ops team needs either: 1) an e-notary certificate attached to the W-8BEN-E, or 2) a notarized hard copy with an apostille for non-US jurisdictions. Since Harborline is US‑based, an e-notary or a notarized scanned copy will generally suffice.

A couple of items the team will check before PO creation:
- Confirm the signer's authority (title listed on W-8BEN-E must match corporate resolution or officer title). Please confirm the signer's title on the form (CEO is fine) and attach a photo ID or passport copy.
- Bank letter must show account name and routing details that match the W-8BEN-E entity name.
- If you have an internal onboarding contact (procurement billing contact) please provide that name/email so we can attach it to the PO record.

If you can provide a passport scan and a quick note confirming that the hard notarized copy will be couriered within 7 business days, we can move forward with conditional PO creation (Procurement will create the PO but mark it as pending until tax ops clears the docs). Ive looped in Marissa and Kimberly to kick off the procurement and tax checks.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Procurement Operations
